patch_description: Expand basin coverage: generate deterministic jittered variants for every valid row-set layout (not just cands[0]), plus radius-scale diversification. Prior data shows seed diversity was the gating factor (0.64→0.99), so multiplying initial layouts cheaply increases the chance SLSQP finds the 2.635 basin. Keep jitter count modest (3 per layout) to control runtime, since COBYLA stage already costs time.
